relations: Dry spaghetti angled into boiling water will soften and bend as submerged portions absorb heat.
Vigorous bubbling agitates the pasta, making flexible submerged ends sway and shift in the pot.
As saturation spreads upward, rigid dry ends gradually lose stiffness and droop into the water.
